response.justification: The candidate has genuine geospatial interest (founder of GISCollective, Green Map GIS work) and proven low-latency systems experience handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby, but that work was in DLang, not the required C++ or Rust. His C++ experience is limited to a brief 7-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, and recent roles have been TypeScript/Node full-stack work. There is no navigation, routing, or map-tiling pipeline experience, which is central to this role, though his demonstrated adaptability and systems background could make him worth a conversation if the team is flexible on language background.
strengths: Founded and maintains an open-source geospatial data platform (GISCollective)
Real low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby
Strong testing culture and craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks)
concerns: Minimal modern C++ experience (brief role in 2014-2015) and no Rust
No routing, navigation guidance, or tile-generation pipeline experience
Recent years focused on TypeScript/Node web product work, far from the role's core stack
